fontsUnderTest: fixtures/corpus/fonts/_assets/manifest.json (unmodified Heebo 3.100 and Source Sans 3 3.052R, OFL-1.1); extra sources pinned in sources.json

isolation.fontsMovedOut: The seven pinned faces (installed for #32 in the QA user's ~/Library/Fonts) were moved outside every font directory for the run and restored afterwards with verified SHA-256.
isolation.systemCheck: NSFontManager availableFontFamilies/availableFonts contained no Heebo or Source Sans family/face during every run (183 families) and both again after restore (185).
isolation.officeCloudFonts: Office's cloud-font catalog on this host lists Heebo (Thin..Black) but not Source Sans 3. With the fonts removed, PowerPoint downloaded cloud Heebo (4 faces) on first open even with OfficeExperiencesDownloadingContentPreference=FALSE, and still rendered cloud Heebo with a read-only CloudFonts cache. Isolation required BOTH com.microsoft.office ConnectedOfficeExperiencesPreference=FALSE and a read-only FontCache/4/CloudFonts directory; both were restored afterwards (originally TRUE / writable, cache holding only Segoe UI).

controls.before: control-no-embedding: every box rendered in Calibri (PDF fonts Calibri*), line breaks differ from the fonts-installed baseline
controls.after: control-after: identical Calibri fallback; no Heebo/Source Sans in the cloud cache or system — no embedded face leaked between cases

isolation.perCaseProcess: PowerPoint was quit and relaunched between cases and between save and reopen.
isolation.developerMachine: unchanged; all PowerPoint work ran on the separate QA Mac

powerpointNativeEmbedding.how: With the fonts installed, PowerPoint opened the deckflip #32 office-identity package with embedTrueTypeFonts="1" (and saveSubsetFonts="1" for the subset variant), and saved in place. Packages: ref/powerpoint-embed-all.pptx, ref/powerpoint-embed-subset.pptx.
notes: PowerPoint writes EOT 2.2 with MicroType Express compression (flags 0x4; 0x5 when subsetting).
Its own slot choices are not RIBBI-correct: 'Heebo' regular holds Heebo Medium bytes and 'Heebo ExtraBold' uses the bold slot for a Regular-style face.
AppleScript `save p in <path> as save as Open XML presentation` wrote a copy with no embedded fonts and no embedTrueTypeFonts; only an in-place save embedded.
